ad_master_switch.description: Master toggle to instantly disable all ads across the app.

ad_native_enabled.description: Toggle native ads in content feeds.

ad_banner_enabled.description: Toggle persistent banner ads at the bottom of the screen.

ad_interstitial_enabled.description: Toggle full-screen interstitial ads between screen transitions.

ad_rewarded_enabled.description: Toggle rewarded video ads for unlocking premium features.

ad_app_open_enabled.description: Toggle app open ads when the user returns to the app from the background.
